verdict.rationale: Apple documents concrete external connectivity specs (Thunderbolt 5 at up to 120Gb/s, external display limits) and memory bandwidth for M4 Max, giving developers some hard numbers to plan a dock/build around. However there is no documented PCIe generation/lane count or SSD/storage throughput specs anywhere in the pack, which are core parts of the story. missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane count, fast storage (SSD) speed specs, independent hands-on validation of I/O throughput.
